g.text: Historical online learning: train and evaluation are not interchangeable
Thin lines: individual training seeds. Thick curves: seed mean; pale envelope: observed seed range, NOT a confidence interval.
The fixed 65,536-interaction checkpoint was evaluated; no best-checkpoint selection. Direct-PPO 32k validation is not available.
